architectural_commitments: one source-identical six-bin normalized-LMS update table with fixed log2 innovation edges -4 -2 0 2 4 and fixed rates 0.03125 0.0625 0.125 0.25 0.5 1 2
meta-fit learns only the median next-row-optimal rate in each bin from assigned anonymous source worlds with smallest-rate tie breaking and default rate 1 when a bin has no evidence
every test world starts with fresh zero predictor weights and adapts sequentially only on its public support rows; no fitted world weights covariance examples or hidden state transfer
shared independent cross-family-only and support-only use exactly one module and constants and differ only in assigned source worlds
the rule is coordinate-aggregate and must commute with consistent anonymous channel permutation; no family labels paths native types semantic names or hand ontology
charge source acquisition meta-fit every support update autoregressive query bytes resident and peak state and R1 R4 R16 workload
change_note: Created after review cycle 125 and protected v7 migration cycle 126, before candidate implementation, plan creation or scoring-seed realization. Confidence is intentionally low; one valid negative quick ends the exact direction without tuning.
cheapest_falsification: One runner-random quick on heldout_three_family_continuous_transfer_v7 at K=4/6/9 against the four source-identical causal roles and all nine frozen controls.
evidence_against: EXP-20260830-0043 found an earlier learned meta-update strongly dominated by fixed LMS under a short-phase synthetic battery.
Recent heterogeneous transfer learners repeatedly failed because anonymous columns lacked shared semantic coordinates.
Meta-AF is direct prior art, so a learned updater must beat LMS/RLS-style controls on full cost rather than claim novelty.
evidence_for: EXP-0043 left a specific identifiability confound because every implementable method had zero worst-phase accuracy under short random phases.
The frozen v7 worlds have public support and strong complete linear/probabilistic controls, permitting a cleaner test of update-rule rather than parameter transfer.
A six-scalar rule transfers much less world-specific state than the parameter-sharing, spectral, predictive-index, convex-mixture and residual mechanisms already rejected.
falsification_criteria: discard if shared minus independent gain is not greater than 0.03806855146519833 in every family and K cell
discard if cross-family-only minus support-only gain is not greater than 0.03806855146519833 in every family and K cell
discard if shared worst-family quality regresses relative to the strongest complete implementable control or stable rollout rate is below 1
discard if any fixed complete implementable control Pareto-dominates shared after acquisition fit adaptation update query state bytes and R1 R4 R16 workload
invalidate on any frozen table rule constant threshold seed policy evaluator manifest preflight or mandatory-baseline mismatch target leakage external model API or post-score tuning
motivation: Test a transfer level not used by the recent failed portfolio: learn how to update a fresh world-local predictor, while transferring no world model parameters, latent coordinates, residual trajectory, index or expert weights.
next_experiment: Preregister EXP-20260831-0009 quick on active heldout_three_family_continuous_transfer_v7 with one runner-random seed, the four exact local-update-law roles and all nine frozen controls before implementing the candidate. A valid negative ends this exact rule without tuning; one positive seed can only authorize unchanged replication.
predicted_signatures: both causal gains exceed 0.03806855146519833 separately in every evaluator-private family and K=4/6/9 cell
shared has no worst-family regression and stable rollout rate equals 1
mean local update work is bounded by the fixed support length and the six-scalar transferred state is independent of source-world count
shared is not Pareto-dominated by fixed LMS/RLS-style or probabilistic controls after full end-to-end accounting

prior_art.relationship: Direct prior art for learned adaptive-filter update rules; a positive result would concern cross-family transfer and full-cost efficiency under the frozen NEXTAI contract, not novelty of meta-learning.
prior_art.title: Meta-AF: Meta-Learning for Adaptive Filters

statement: A family-blind update law learned from anonymous source trajectories can adapt freshly initialized world-local predictors on unseen heterogeneous worlds with better transfer quality per full update and inference cost than fixed classical adaptive rules, without transferring world parameters.
title: Transferable local update law without world-parameter sharing
